product_metadata.title: Mini Bag Sealer, Chip Bag Sealer, Handheld Heat Sealer, Food Storage Snack Fresh Mini Portable Sealer
features: ☛2-in-1 Sealer and Cutter: One end of the sealing machine can seal the bag, the whole process will not exceed 10 seconds; the other end can cut the bag, and it can be cut in just 1 second.
☛Keep Foods Fresh: With this heat sealer, you can re-use the original bag, keep foods and snacks fresher, reduce food waste.
☛Easy to use: Comes with a use manual. Press sealer for about 3-5 seconds to start heating. Put the bag to be sealed in the middle and slowly pull it at a constant speed.
☛Compact and Portable: this mini bag sealer length only 14 cm, which can be put into your pocket, and is most suitable for travel and carrying.
☛HIGH QUALITY - Durable: Made from ABS material, it can resistance to high and low temperatures that make it live longer.
description: Why choose our 2 in 1 bag sealer?
1.The sealing function comes with a broken package function, tearing open no longer need to find scissors!Perfect replacement for open-cut scissors or other dangerous tools.
2.Portable and mini design sealer perfect for Picnic, travel and gift giving.
3. Easy to use, just clamp and close the sealer to the bag and it will seal immediately.
4. With this mini bag sealer, you can take it and use it to open the snack food bags whatever you sitting on the living room, in kitchen or while watching TV.
A good kitchen helper, sealing various bags!

Mini Bag Sealer has been improved and upgraded for many times, Appropriated for various bags, Coated aluminum foil bags are recommended PP, PE, PVC bags with thickness no more than 0.3mm. Such as storage bags, potato chip bags, fruit bags, sugar bags and so on.
Install the battery according to the "+"" -" at the bottom of the battery compartment of the product. If the battery is reversed, the sealer will not heat up.
When the battery power is insufficient, the sealing effect will be affected. Please replace the battery.
Please remove the battery if it is not used for a long time.
Please don’t use hard or sharp items to insert in the heating film of the sealing area, to avoid damaging the bag heat sealer.
Please keep this bag heat sealer away from children’s touching.
To avoid any defect, please keep the bag heat sealer clean and dry; once getting moisture, please dry it with a cloth in time.
